ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, 'freshwater snail' is located in the lower, slightly middle-right position, and nearby there is an arrow pointing from it to the 'dragonfly larvae' above. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate food or energy flowing from the organism being eaten to the predator. If all freshwater snails die, the dragonfly larvae that directly feed on them or depend on them would lose a food source, so the ones most affected are dragon flies / dragonfly larvae.
